scope: Real source in Node VM; fake image transport, virtual timers and recording canvas. Not art or browser certification.

checks.name: Six stalled images time out and release the seventh queued request
Timed-out preload resolves false instead of hanging forever
Late callbacks from an expired image cannot settle its retry
Source assignment failures settle as errors without consuming queue capacity
Evicted failed assets stay negative-cached until explicitly retried
An explicit retry recovers an evicted failure on its next request
Retry keeps the failure visible until successful image recovery
A successful portrait does not erase a failed sprite of the same path
Synchronous image completion does not leak timers or load slots
Success detaches stale callbacks and cancels the timeout
Tainted matte readback is attempted only once per decoded image/tolerance
Changing the reviewed matte tolerance allows exactly one new read attempt
Failed matte attempts release temporary canvases without destroying the original
Fallback to the original re-resolves its own direction, not the failed derivative mirror
Cache and failure diagnostics stay bounded across large error sets
R4 assets/art and R5 baselines retained, R6 combat edits checked explicitly
